summary: Add `agent_card(tenant_id, employee_id, kc_client_id, llm_endpoint, llm_model, llm_secret_handle, autonomy_threshold, budget_policy_id, escalation_rule_id, created_at, updated_at)` as a separate tenant-isolated table keyed to `employee(kind=agent)`, migration 032, dev-seeded for 5 agent employees, runtime-dormant day-1; downstream contracts for T-0042/T-0024/T-0025/T-0043 frozen.
functional: FR-1 agent_card table with 11 columns, PK(tenant_id, employee_id), UNIQUE(tenant_id, kc_client_id)
FR-2 constraint: agent_card.employee_id must reference an employee row with kind='agent'
FR-3 T-0013 isolation invariants: tenant_id leading, FORCE RLS, default-DENY, choros_app SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE only
FR-5 dev seed (migration 032, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) for 5 agent employees with kc_client_id
FR-6 no runtime code reads agent_card on day-1 (schema-dormant)
FR-7 kc_client_id column is the frozen linkage seam: employee.slug maps to KC clientId, consumed by T-0042/T-0024/T-0060
FR-8 escalation_rule_id is uuid NULL without FK (target table does not exist yet)
FR-9 budget_policy_id is uuid NULL; FK to instance_budget deferred if T-0023 not yet applied
non_functional: NF-2 known_tenant_tables.txt updated, cross-tenant test needs no source change
NF-3 llm_secret_handle is an opaque handle reference, not a raw secret at rest
NF-4 autonomy_threshold CHECK BETWEEN 0 AND 1, numeric(5,4), NULL allowed
NF-5 migration seam: 031 occupied by T-0044, T-0020 uses 032
NF-6 no new TypeScript runtime module delivered by T-0020
out_of_scope: agent runtime: autonomy downgrade, budget enforcement, A2A breakers (Stage-2 E5.7-E5.10)
KC service-account provisioning for s-ledger / s-ocr (T-0042)
HTTP endpoints reading or writing agent_card (T-0042)

acceptance_criteria.text: Migration file migrations/032_agent_card.sql exists; has CREATE TABLE choros.agent_card with PK (tenant_id, employee_id), UNIQUE (tenant_id, kc_client_id), and all 11 columns from FR-1.
agent_card has FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and a USING (tenant_id = current_setting('choros.tenant_id', true)::uuid) policy.
A cross-tenant read on agent_card (tenant B context, tenant A data) returns 0 rows.
A cross-tenant write on agent_card (tenant B context, tenant A tenant_id) is rejected (0 rows inserted / RLS violation).
INSERT into agent_card referencing an employee.id with kind='human' is rejected at the DB layer.
INSERT into agent_card referencing an employee.id with kind='agent' succeeds.
autonomy_threshold CHECK constraint: value 1.5 is rejected; 0.0, 0.5, 1.0 are accepted; NULL is accepted.
ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt contains 'agent_card'; the cross-tenant CI tests pass for agent_card without modification to the test source.
After applying migration 032, all 5 agent employees (a-recon, a-invoice, a-triage, s-ledger, s-ocr) have an agent_card row with matching kc_client_id.
kc_client_id UNIQUE constraint per tenant: inserting two agent_card rows with the same (tenant_id, kc_client_id) is rejected.
Migration 032 is idempotent: running the migration runner twice produces no error.
No Choros runtime code path imports or reads agent_card on day-1: grep -r 'agent_card' src/ returns 0 matches in any .ts file outside __tests__/migrations/.
choros_app role has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on agent_card and no DDL.
tsc --noEmit, eslint, and npm run fitness (existing) are all green after migration 032 is added.
llm_secret_handle column is text NULL: a 512-character string is accepted; column has no length constraint below 512.
budget_policy_id is uuid NULL; if instance_budget table does not exist at migration time, the column has no FK constraint and migration still succeeds.
escalation_rule_id is uuid NULL with NO FK constraint in migration 032 (target table does not exist yet).
